newshape.description: tuple A tuple indicating the shape of the mask.
constraints: The returned mask has the same shape as specified by newshape.

dtype.description: {None, dtype}, optional If None, use a MaskType instance. Otherwise, use a new datatype with the same fields as `dtype`, converted to boolean types.
constraints: If specified, must be a valid numpy dtype.
If a complex dtype is specified for dtype, the resulting mask will have the same number of fields as `dtype`, but with boolean types.

output.description: ------- ndarray An ndarray of appropriate shape and dtype, filled with False.

constraints: All entries in the output array are False.
